contamination_assertion.note: contamination check for pubmedqa not wired in Phase 3

metrics.macro_f1_note: position-bias check, NOT a skill metric for 3-option MCQ; Accuracy is the headline
metrics.verifier_decision_rate_note: fraction of questions where exactly one option verified SUPPORTED (verifier decided) vs. fell back to B2-style generation. A high fallback rate is direct evidence for the binary bottleneck C2 targets, not a defect of this run.

superseded_reason: PubMedQA baseline prompt superseded (ADR-030). v1 lettered the yes/no/maybe answers A/B/C; v2 added a 'use maybe when mixed/insufficient' hint. Both produced a degenerate one-class predictor. Superseded by the word-framed 'give your best single answer: yes, no, or maybe' run in superseded_by. Retained as the prompt-sensitivity comparison in docs/04 SS5.4; never tabulate as a headline result.
